Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"freakdrivr" <freak...@ponymail.com> wrote in message
news:fc6a5b20.02010...@posting.google.com...


Humanitas, Master
Unique Master. Put this card on a ready vampire you control. When attempting
to rescue a vampire from torpor, this vampire gets +1 stealth and burns 1
less blood if successful. This vampire cannot commit diablerie.

Catacombs, Equipment, 1 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as
equipment while in play. When attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor,
the vampire with this location gets +1 stealth and burns 1 less blood if
successful.

Sense Vitality, Action, 1 blood, Valeren/Fortitude
+1 stealth action.
[for]: This vampire gains 2 blood.
[val]: Rescue a vampire from torpor (this action costs 2 less blood than the
normal rescue action).
<VAL>: As [val] above, and move one blood from the blood bank to the rescued
vampire.

It's not a "rescue from torpor" action. It's a "Sense Vitality" action.
Sense Vitality does qualify for the + stealth because Catacombs and
Humanitas say "attemting to rescue a vampire from torpor" and Sense
Vitality(S) says "rescue a vampire from torpor". So attempting a Sense
Vitality is attempting to rescue a vampire from torpor.

Catacombs and Humanitas will not reduce the cost of Sense Vitality however.
